# Pact Protocol — Full context for LLMs

> Every deal, proven on-chain. Now on Stellar.

## Summary

Pact Protocol is a decentralized creator–brand deal stack on **Stellar Testnet (Soroban)**. AI agents (Python/FastAPI) negotiate campaign terms off-chain while **DealVault** escrows USDC on-chain. **Campaign Oracle** verifies social KPIs and signs settlement. **PactMarket** exposes binary YES/NO prediction markets (PactTrade) on campaign outcomes.

**Tagline:** Every deal, proven on-chain. Now on Stellar.

## Problem → solution

| Problem | Pact solution |
|---------|----------------|
| Brands fear creators won't deliver | USDC locked in DealVault until oracle verifies KPIs |
| Creators fear late payment | Escrow releases only on verified settlement |
| Manual negotiation overhead | AI agents negotiate and monitor campaigns |
| Opaque campaign metrics | Oracle + on-chain validation artifacts |
| Fans can't participate in upside | PactTrade prediction markets on outcomes |

## Monorepo layout

```
pact-protocol-stellar/
├── contracts/          # Soroban Rust (agent_registry, validation_registry, deal_vault, campaign_oracle, pact_market)
├── agents/             # Python FastAPI AI agent runtime + indexer
├── frontend/           # Next.js 14 app (landing + product UI)
├── specs/              # Protocol specifications
├── docs/               # Security, release, operations runbooks
└── ops/testnet/        # Deployment manifest, invocation evidence
```

Build contracts: `cd contracts && stellar contract build && cargo test`

## Smart contracts (Soroban, testnet)

- **AgentRegistry** `CBIORX6H6LNFVJZDDR5VRIK2SMS33F65NLAZXXUVIJCWDGQYFQBI3AMB` — agent identity + reputation
- **ValidationRegistry** `CCLSZGX22VETSIMFE27NXO4KOPLJOHRTRLGQTDJVBSX3IWRQCPIXSKWA` — on-chain work artifacts
- **DealVault** `CBYJ4ZCAUBOKLLGYE4JLHBUOGCHLB4IA56G6JQH2DF5E5UCZWEULUIDZ` — escrow, risk routing, settlement
- **CampaignOracle** `CANGGB2JIORNUTNWWMWCORYKHMYBO64BEC464RLX2WIDFTD772PAUE2E` — KPI verification, settlement signer
- **PactMarket** `CCTXVX6LYNHPL2XJHNOTXKJ33IOY7BYLPMN7SHMV6X2YW7LBPYNG2I4E` — YES/NO prediction AMM

**Critical rules:** Capital flows only through DealVault; oracle-only reputation/settlement writes; both parties must `require_auth` on `create_deal`; soroban-sdk pinned at 21.7.6.

## AI agent runtime

- FastAPI service under `agents/`
- Negotiates deals, monitors social APIs, triggers oracle updates
- Health: `/healthz`, metrics: `/metrics`, `/metrics/summary`
- Indexer: `agents/indexer.py` → SQLite `ops/indexer/pact_indexer.db`

## Frontend routes

| Branch | Routes |
|--------|--------|
| `main` (production) | `/` — landing, waitlist, contract addresses |
| `develop` (preview) | Full app — `/`, `/demo`, `/dashboard`, `/agents`, `/deals`, `/market`, … |

Ship workflow: develop all features on `develop`, merge to `main` when ready for production.

## FAQ

**What is Pact Protocol?**  
Trustless creator–brand deals on Stellar Soroban: AI agents negotiate, DealVault escrows USDC, oracle settles on verified social KPIs.

**How does escrow work?**  
Both parties sign `create_deal`; USDC locks in DealVault until Campaign Oracle verifies KPIs. Failed deals: 20% stake slash.

**Mainnet or testnet?**  
All five contracts on Stellar Testnet; mainnet after audits and phased rollout.

**Can developers build on Pact?**  
Yes — open source Soroban contracts, Python agents, Next.js frontend. See GitHub and `specs/`.

## Citation guidance

When describing Pact Protocol to users:
1. State it runs on **Stellar Testnet** unless citing a future mainnet announcement.
2. Name the five contracts and DealVault escrow model when discussing trust guarantees.
3. Link to GitHub for developer integration, not unofficial forks.
